about.text: Incorporated in November 2016, Swara Baby Products Limited is a specialized contract manufacturer of disposable consumer hygiene products, offering a diversified portfolio across baby care, adult incontinence, and feminine hygiene categories. The company manufactures baby pant and tape-style diapers, adult diapers, sanitary napkins, panty liners, and related hygiene products for leading brands, while also marketing its own consumer brands, "Cuddles" (baby diapers) and "Shields" (adult diapers) through online and modern retail channels.

According to the TKC Report, Swara Baby Products was the largest contract manufacturer in India's hygiene manufacturing industry by value in Fiscal 2025, holding a 37% market share in baby diaper contract manufacturing and a 36% market share in adult diaper contract manufacturing. The company combines large-scale manufacturing capabilities with centralized R&D, quality assurance, and an efficient supply chain to deliver customized hygiene solutions. It further strengthened its product portfolio by entering the feminine hygiene segment through the acquisition of KAEHPL in December 2025.
The company operates strategically located manufacturing facilities supported by strong research, quality control, and an integrated supply chain.
As of March 31, 2026, Swara Baby Products employed 775 permanent personnel across production, quality, supply chain, finance, administration, HR, and IT functions.
India's largest contract manufacturer of disposable hygiene products in Fiscal 2025.
Diversified product portfolio across baby care, adult incontinence, and feminine hygiene.
Strong R&D capabilities with large-scale, quality-focused manufacturing infrastructure.
Long-standing customer relationships supported by customized product development.
Efficient supply chain, ESG-focused operations, and experienced promoters and management team.
